generated.description: A seaside row of modernist townhouses in the De Stijl style, built mostly from stone and black and red terracotta with spruce accents, set along a sandy, icy shoreline with water. The build is roughly 71 wide, 25 high and 103 deep, about 90,000 blocks. It contains a few chests, hoppers, signs, a beacon and daylight detectors.
